lessonTitle: 74. Distance from a point to a line
lessonTitleEnglish: Distance from a point to a line
unit: Geometry · Chapter 4. Sides and angles of a triangle
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: The length of the perpendicular from a point to a line is the distance from the point to the line.
stages.headlineEnglish: The length of the perpendicular from a point to a line is the distance from the point to the line.

stages.headline: Any oblique is longer than the perpendicular, since a hypotenuse is longer than a leg.
stages.headlineEnglish: Any oblique is longer than the perpendicular, since a hypotenuse is longer than a leg.

stages.headline: Example: the shortest path from a road to a house is the perpendicular.
stages.headlineEnglish: Example: the shortest path from a road to a house is the perpendicular.
